title: Topic 5.4: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse

pages.lesson:
LESSON: ALCOHOL, DRUGS AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.4: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do young people abuse alcohol and drugs?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse
   In simple words: practise until you can explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse in the examples.
2. Explain Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse.
4. Show that you can: explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Alcohol, Drugs and Substance Abuse important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Brainstorm on the dangers of using and abusing alcohol and drugs,
2. In pairs read Ephesians 5:18, Hosea 4:11 and discuss Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse,
3. Discuss strategies used by Christians to prevent alcohol, drugs, and substance abuse,
4. In pairs discuss measures taken by government agencies to fight drug trafficking and abuse,
5. Self-efficacy: the skill of exhibiting responsibility is demonstrated as learners choose to do what is right by avoiding alcohol, drugs and substance abuse.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do young people abuse alcohol and drugs?
2. How can you avoid alcohol, drugs and substance abuse?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain Christian teachings on the dangers of alcohol, drugs and substance abuse

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
